generated.what_happened: DonnaJean Wilde, a 61-year-old Canadian grandmother of 12, completed a five-hour plank hold at the Huntsman World Senior Games in Utah, surpassing her previous record of 4 hours, 30 minutes, and 11 seconds. The attempt lasted from 3:03 p.m. to 8:03 p.m. under the observation of rotating judges, with encouragement from the audience helping her endure the final minutes. Guinness World Records has received the application for the attempt and is currently reviewing the evidence to officially confirm the new record. If ratified, this would mark Wilde's third Guinness World Record title.
